name: Jinnai Heita
source:
"I'm Jinnai Heita, the man aiming to be a man!" 

 The self-styled "Man aiming for manhood". As you could tell from his looks, he isn't strong. Even if he's trying to act cool he gives out halfway through the third sheet.

 Battle quote - "I'm Jinnai Heita, the man who wants to be a MAN! I'm so hot you're gonna burn!" 
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
